question: How do I change my published site to journal without losing my other design settings?
expected: Edit existing chulapa-skin.skin journal preserve vars/settings; exact name, no duplicate sections; commit Actions published home/article/mobile, overrides can preserve old colors; preview choice not saved; local Jekyll restart.

result.answer:
To change your skin to `journal` while preserving your existing design settings, edit your `_config.yml` file. You must replace only the `skin` value within the existing `chulapa-skin` mapping and keep all other `vars`, `highlight`, and settings intact.

```yaml
chulapa-skin:
  skin: journal
```

**Next steps:**
1. Commit the changes to your publishing branch.
2. Wait for GitHub Actions to complete.
3. Check your home, articles, and menu pages, including mobile views and color contrast.
4. Restart Jekyll if you are working locally.

Note: Previewing does not save your settings.

[Changing skins and colors](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/22-choose-skin)
[Changing colors](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/23-change-color)

question: How do I put a short information box in an existing post without wrapping the previous list?
expected: Link /docs/49-add-alert. Edit body below front matter; blank line before paragraph, attribute line immediately next line {: .alert .alert-info .p-3 .mx-2 .mb-3}. Use warning only for concrete avoid/fix issue. kramdown parser support; commit/publish/check box boundaries. No new YAML setting.

result.answer:
To add a short information box (alert) to an existing post, insert a blank line, your text, and then the specific class on the next line. This method allows you to place the box anywhere within the article content without affecting existing structures like lists.

```liquid
This is my existing paragraph.

This is the information box content.
{: .alert .alert-info .p-3 .mx-2 .mb-3}

This is the next paragraph.
```

**Next Step:**
Check the published article on narrow screens to ensure the alert displays correctly.

**Source:**
[Add alerts](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/49-add-alert)
